payload.description: Raw rank must be an exact integer in 1..10 inclusive. Missing or null is invalid (no default). Accept only exact integers 1..10; reject bool/float/string/wrong types. Always result={accepted:boolean, rank:original if accepted else null}. No exceptions, no coercion. Target typed inputs interface requires selected-runner support; unapproved draft, not submitted or activated.
